title: Manoj Saxena v. Managing Director, Paschimanchal Electricity and Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Kshitij Shailendra, J.
disposition: Disposed; decide objection under Supply Code within eight weeks
headnote: Writ against a notice of provisional assessment in an electricity-theft case disposed of. If no final assessment order had been passed, respondent no. 2 was directed to decide the petitioner's objection by the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, within eight weeks of communication of the order.
facts: Manoj Saxena challenged a notice of provisional assessment dated 22 December 2022 issued by respondent no. 2 in a case of theft of electricity. The respondents were the Managing Director, Paschimanchal Electricity, and two others. Saxena had made a representation against the proposed assessment and asked the High Court only to direct the authority to decide it. Counsel for the licensee stated that if no final assessment order had yet been passed, respondent no. 2 would examine the objection and decide the matter.

holding_units.topic: objection to provisional assessment in a theft case
holding_units.holding: If a final assessment order has not been passed, the authority that issued a notice of provisional assessment in a theft-of-electricity case must decide the consumer's objection by following the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, within eight weeks of communication of the order. The writ is disposed of on that direction, without a decision on the assessment.
holding_units.flag: Order cites the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and no numbered clause; clause is not corrected or inferred.

principle_tags.application: The Court did not adjudicate the theft assessment. On the licensee's statement, it directed respondent no. 2, if no final assessment had been passed, to decide the objection under the Supply Code, 2005 procedure within eight weeks.

not_decided.point: Whether a final assessment order had already been passed
not_decided.note: The direction operates only if final assessment has not been passed.

not_decided.point: Merits of the provisional assessment and of the petitioner's objection
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 2 to decide under the prescribed procedure.
